To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the container, temperature, and storage time are all important considerations when determining sample acceptance policies for whole blood intended for molecular genetic diagnostic testing.
refrigerated blood samples in EDTA tubes stored for 10-130 days are the best choice to isolate high quality genomic DNA for downstream applications.
whole blood samples stored in EDTA tubes for 130 days at 4 ° C yielded the best quality gDNA for downstream applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the storage conditions of whole blood and their effects on the quality of genomic DNA.
the quality of genomic DNA isolated from whole blood samples stored at 4 ° C or at room temperature for various lengths of time.
the effects of container type, temperature, and time on the degradation of gDNA isolated from whole blood samples.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
whole blood samples stored at room temp in EDTA tubes are the optimal conditions for gDNA isolation.
whole blood samples stored in EDTA at 4 ° C are the optimal choice when gDNA is required.

the storage of whole blood for gDNA extraction should be in EDTA tubes refrigerated for 10 or more days, in EDTA or heparin tubes refrigerated for up to 10 days, or in EDTA tubes stored at room temperature for up to 3 days.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best quality genomic DNA was obtained from EDTA blood samples stored at 4°C for 3 to 130 days.
blood stored at room temperature in EDTA tubes for less than 10 days and heparinized tubes for less than nine days can be used for gDNA extraction.
refrigerated EDTA samples stored for up to 3 days at 4 ° C are ideal for gDNA extraction for downstream molecular diagnostic testing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
gDNA from EDTA samples is superior to heparin samples and that storage at 4 ° C is superior to storage at room temperature for gDNA extraction.
refrigerated blood samples stored in EDTA tubes yield the highest quality genomic DNA.
blood samples should be stored at 4 ° C in EDTA tubes for long term storage.
